title: CFOオフィス（M＆A推進担当）
description: 新CFOのもと、財務・経理領域にとどまらず、全社的な経営課題・変革テーマへの取り組みを強化しています。CFOオフィスでは、CFO直下で、複数部門にまたがる経営課題、新規テーマ、重要プロジェクトの企画・推進を担っています。今後はこれらに加え、海外企業を対象としたM&Aや戦略投資等についても、CFOの立場から検討・実行する機能を強化していく予定です。そのため、CFOの意思決定や社内外への発信を支えるとともに、重要な経営テーマを自ら構造化し、国内外の関係者を巻き込みながら実行まで推進できる人材（主にM&A推進を担当）を募集します。
requirements: ■必須要件  ・海外関係者との会議・協議、資料作成、メール等を英語で円滑に行うことができるビジネスレベルの英語力（※案件コミュニケーションは英語必須になります）・コンサルティングファーム、FAS、投資銀行、または事業会社の経営企画・M&A部門等における実務経験・PowerPoint等を用いた経営層・クライアント向けプレゼンテーション資料の作成経験・Excelを用いた財務分析・データ分析能力・複数の関係者を巻き込みながらプロジェクトを推進する能力・以下のいずれかの経験　・FASにおけるM&Aアドバイザリー、Transaction Services、Valuation等の経験　・戦略系・総合系コンサルティングファームにおけるM&A、事業戦略、全社改革等の経験　・投資銀行、PEファンド、事業会社等でのM&A実務経験　・財務デューデリジェンス、バリュエーション、財務モデリング等の経験　・PMIまたはM&A後の事業管理経験　・クロスボーダーM&Aまたは海外プロジェクトへの参画経験　・公認会計士、USCPA等の資格またはそれに準ずる財務・会計知識

description:

Job Function: 

Discovery & Pre-Clinical/Clinical Development

Job Sub Function: 

Clinical Development & Research – Non-MD

Job Category:

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan

Job Description:

ABOUT INNOVATIVE MEDICINE

 

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

 

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

 

We are searching for the best talent for an Oncology Clinical Scientist (Manager) to join our Clinical Development team in Japan.

 

 

Purpose:

 

Help bring innovative oncology medicines to patients in Japan. In this role, you will drive the development and execution of the Japan Clinical Development Plan, working closely with the Global Clinical Development Team to align it with global asset and program strategies. Through clinical science support for studies conducted in Japan, from protocol development through to PMDA interactions, you will help deliver high-quality, compliant and timely clinical development outcomes, with the opportunity to contribute to global studies as a Study Responsible Scientist. Based on the clinical trial results obtained, you will also lead the regulatory submission for approval in Japan.

 

You will be responsible for:

Contributing to Japan clinical development strategies aligned to global asset and program plans, and drafting Japan local protocols, amendments and planning documents
Leading local companion diagnostic (CDx) development with support from the global CDx team
Providing clinical oversight of trials in Japan, partnering with Clinical Operations on feasibility, investigator interactions, site training, enrolment and protocol interpretation
Supporting and performing eligibility and medical review, and interpreting study results with the broader study team to inform trial conduct, development strategy and regulatory decisions
Contributing to key clinical documents, including clinical study reports, protocols, informed consent documents and CRFs, through section authorship and quality control
Preparing clinical sections of Japan regulatory submissions and responses to PMDA inquiries, and participating in PMDA consultation meetings
Contributing to global study activities when assigned as a Global Study Responsible Scientist (SRS)
 

 

Key interfaces

Global Clinical Development Team (CDT) and Clinical Operations (GCO)
Biostatistics, data management, safety/pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, medical writing, quality, translational sciences and medical affairs
PMDA
Investigators, key opinion leaders, external advisors and vendors
 

Measures of success

High-quality, compliant and timely delivery of Japan clinical studies and Japan components of global trials
Scientifically accurate, consistent and compliant clinical documents and regulatory submissions
Timely identification and escalation of clinical issues
Strong cross-functional alignment across the global and local matrix
 

Qualifications / Requirements

Bachelor's degree or above in biology, pharmacology or a related scientific field; PhD preferred
Minimum 5 years' oncology clinical research experience in pharmaceutical clinical development, or equivalent experience in academic institutions
Solid understanding of ICH-GCP and the Japan regulatory environment
Ability to work effectively in both Japanese and global (English-speaking) matrix teams
Sound scientific judgement and strong communication skills
 

Accountability principles

Delivers assigned clinical development activities with guidance and growing independence
Performs regulatory activities with appropriate supervision, ensuring scientific accuracy and compliance
Identifies and escalates clinical issues appropriately, in line with standard clinical development practices
